title: Add demotion and re-promotion paths to MemoryStateMachine
description:
P1 finding (recalibrated from P2 by council). MemoryStateMachine has no demotion path (Core records never transition back to Working when score drops) and no re-promotion from Deprecated (records stay Deprecated forever even if score recovers). Add bidirectional state transitions.

File: MemorySmith.Core/StateMachine/MemoryStateMachine.cs (lines 17-28)
Confidence: 100%
Council notes: Recalibrated from P2 to P1 because no demotion creates irreversible wiki quality decay.
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md, council-codebase-audit-20260710.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Added demotion (Core→Working when score < CoreThreshold) and re-promotion (Deprecated→Working when score >= WorkingThreshold) paths to MemoryStateMachine. Added 4 new test cases to StateTransitionTests. Verified: all 7 state transition tests pass. Commit 6281037.
